//: HelmDeck's OWN settings layer for a card worker. Passed to the CLI as
`--settings ops/harness/settings/card.json`, on top of `--setting-sources project`.
WHAT THAT COMBINATION BUYS (probed against CLI 2.1.207, not assumed):
user layer    OFF - the operator's personal ~/.claude never reaches a card.
That layer carries an `rtk hook claude` PreToolUse hook on EVERY
Bash call (296 observed failures leaking into card transcripts),
a pinned `model: claude-fable-5[1m]` that silently overrode the
card's own model pick, ~150 skillOverrides and personal plugins.
None of it is the card's business, and the card cannot fix it.
project layer ON  - the repo's .claude/settings.json still applies, so a card
keeps the build-loop hooks it is SUPPOSED to have: the Stop hook
(ops/tools/loop_state.py --stop-hook), SessionStart re-orientation,
and the design PostToolUse hook.
this file     ON  - anything HelmDeck wants true for every card and nothing else.
NEVER put a secret in here: this file is tracked in git, which is exactly why it
is safe to hand to a sandboxed worker.
MEMORY IS READ-ONLY (2026-08-16, debt: card-shares-the-operators-auto-memory).
Every surface's memory_paths.auto resolves to ONE directory - the operator's
personal ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/memory/ - and --setting-sources does not move
it. Unlike everything else this file isolates, that directory carries NO git
history: `git -C ~/.claude status` is 'not a git repository', so a card write
there is not reversible the way a tracked-file edit is. Measured against the real
CLI (drivers.build_argv + the real card settings, not a synthetic stand-in): a
card COULD write and edit files there before this entry existed, and the
Write()/Edit() deny below - the SAME mechanism that already protects
daemon/settings.json above - blocks it cleanly while leaving Read open, so a
card still benefits from accumulated notes without being able to corrupt them.
THE PreToolUse HOOK BELOW (ops/tools/card_tool_guard.py) makes worktree
confinement an EXPLICIT rule instead of an undocumented CLI default - see its
own docstring for the 2026-08-24 probe session that measured the gap.
